When two lovers are bound by the red thread of fate, they are destined to be together forever. But what happens when the thread binds three people together? Hyena Kim and Huiyeong Lee are two souls who have reincarnated countless times throughout history, falling in love only to be torn apart by tragedy in each life. That is, until one day, Huiyeong’s soul is split into two by a servant of Grandma Samsin, the deity of lovers. With the red thread of fate tying Hyena to both halves of Huiyeong, who will she choose for her chance at everlasting love?

Now Sister Mary has sent the three children to a boarding school in the city. There is a secret confessional room at the ruins of a chapel near the school, and it is rumored that if you confess your troubles there, strange miracles will occur. Known to be very strong and fearless, he quickly became a national hero because of his charisma and the fight he led. Here is the detailed adaptation of his life.

Note: This was first published as 21 volumes but a complete edition was later released consisting of 32 volumes in total.

148619.description:
Juliette Wright, an ordinary college girl, is abducted on the way to see her boyfriend in broad daylight. Tied up and bagged with another unfortunate victim, Juliette slowly tires out and falls asleep. After she wakes up, the other victim - a smart-looking young man, manages to untie them both and escape. What awaits Juliette back home though, is not a warm embrace from her boyfriend, but slut-shaming and the end of the relationship just because she fed the victim water with her mouth. However, Juliette will soon find out that her new boss, Darren Martin, is the victim whom she spent days with.

148647.description:
Hina was often unable to play with her friends because of her physical condition, forced to stay home in solitude. One day, Hina runs away from home out of sadness at not being able to join a field trip, and she meets a handsome older boy, Yusei Sakaki. Since then, Yusei often comes to Hina's house to play with her, but as he spends time with the innocent Hina, a dark expression sometimes shows on his face...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes five extras chapters.

148649.description:
"I've had a crush on you for 10 years. Today, this time, I won't miss this chance —”

Hiiragi has just broken up with her boyfriend. Then, at just the right moment, Rikumi, a junior acquaintance from her college days, who is now a handsome, perfect gentleman who is nicknamed “The King” by everyone around him, shows up at her door. He tells senpai that he knows everything that's been going on with her, and confesses to Hiiragi that he has been in love with her for more than a decade…!

He pampers Hiiragi both physically and emotionally…
A story of doting, obsessive love!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

148662.description:
After being reborn as a baby in a new world, Arendine Ade is determined to make this life better than her last! Once a miserable and underpaid college drop-out, now she is the daughter of a baronet. With an early start to her education, she makes it her goal in this life to become a government employee – everyone knows they get the best benefits, after all. Unfortunately, her diligent studies are interrupted by the appearance of Kiershka Reinfont, the son of the grand duke. Despite his angelic face, he’s a rotten bully with the manners of a devil, and worst of all, he’s taken an interest in Arendine. With her new life at stake, Arendine will do whatever it takes to make sure this new “friend” doesn’t mess things up!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Reason She Is Avoiding Her Childhood Friend

148668.description: Contact bans, patrolling police officers, the constant fear of getting infected: The coronavirus has changed the world. Social distancing is the new normal. The effects of the pandemic have also hit the economy hard, and even Makoto's father's company is struggling to survive financially. One day, Makoto is sitting in the classroom with three other classmates when the world suddenly changes dramatically again: The entire human race has disappeared in one fell swoop - except for Makoto and his three classmates!

148669.description:
When it’s anxious, this particular snow leopard has a habit of biting its own tail. When said snow leopard was delivered to the snow wolf's bedroom, it was shaking with its tail in its jaws. Snow Wolf King: " It's not like I'm gonna devour you. Why are you so scared?" Snow Leopard: " But you might violate me…" Snow Wolf King: " Well, that's too bad. That's exactly what I planned to do." Snow Leopard: " I thought only another snow wolf has the right to be your queen…?" Snow Wolf King: " Was there such a rule? Let me consult with my experts." That marked the beginning of our love story…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Tail and Tale of a Snow Leopard

148672.description: Morio Chito, 41, lives with his wife and daughter and runs his own flower shop. Business is not good, and his wife has taken up a part-time job to help make ends meet. Then, at a class reunion, an old friend Kagayama comes to Morio with a proposition…

148673.description:
The “saint” - the symbol of the Adaeus nation and the voice of God.
Marivel, the thirteenth saint, was blessed with the greatest healing and purifying power of them all.
But one day, she wakes up to find that she has been completely forgotten by everyone around her.

Exiled from the temple as a blasphemer and a fake saint, Marivel suddenly loses everything and ends up in the slums. There, she is reunited with the only priest who has not forgotten her, and they decide to join the selection ceremony for the next saint.

However, there is still someone out there with hostile intentions toward Marivel, and her selection process will be full of troubles…

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

148674.description: One young salaryman, who adores his plug-in, hybrid car that uses both electricity and gasoline, had been using camping in it as an escape plan from everyday life. Suddenly, he finds himself transported to another world with his car. He'll start his life anew in this different world!

148675.description:
Yuri is in a secret relationship with Hagimoto, the ace of the sales department and her coworker. He is all smiles in the office, but when they get home, he is in a bad mood for some reason...?

(Source: FEEL Young, translated)

148677.description:
Ha-Je Kang can’t take it anymore. Pushed to the breaking point by relentless bullying, Ha-Je stands at the edge of the school roof, ready to end it all. But just as he’s about to jump, he’s given a push -- literally -- by a mysterious upperclassman named Si-Un Lee, only to wake up the next day, unscathed. Little does Ha-Je know that Si-Un happens to be one of the most powerful martial artists in the Murim, the hidden world of martial arts. Ha-Je begs Si-Un to train him, but he never could have imagined just how tumultuous things could get in the martial arts underworld…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

148678.description:
Yeo-Rin is a struggling writer who can’t seem to match the success of her previous work. Try as she might, she lacks the inspiration needed for her latest novel. That’s when In-Ha, the former soldier who inspired her best work, comes back into her life. He is still unabashedly blunt, she is still ridiculously stubborn, and they both still harbor feelings from that one night six years ago… In-Ha might be the key to unlocking Yeo-Rin’s next hit, but will it be a love story or just another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

148679.description:
A spider lives in a little girl room. Will she be scared of it ?

Note: 1st published as a doujin online the same day on Comici and Twitter, it was later officially published in Nakayoshi 2022/4 Digital issue after winning the 2nd Nakayoshi×Comici Grand Prize

148681.description:
Although Hao Kongtong was a bandit leader, he was a useless cripple with severed spiritual roots, allowing him to live freely only because he had five highly skilled brothers. Due to his excessive closeness with his brothers, his romantic luck declined, and he couldn't find a wife for a long time, becoming a single dog destined to lack women. Hao Kongtong made a wish, "Heavens! Let me get close to beautiful women!" In the darkness, a fox spirit heard his wish and granted it – turning all five of his brothers into girls!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148682.description: The Northern warlords were at war. Various foreign forces colluded with one another to set their eyes on the Chinese cultural treasure, resulting in the destruction of numerous cultural relics and heritage artifacts lost at sea. The last generation of the tomb masters in the Cao family, Cao Nanwu, stepped up and led Feng Shui slave Xia Kuxue, stele servant Wengzhong and tomb beast Ami to protect the national treasure. Fighting ruthless battles with mysterious organisations such as the Never Night Lights, the Hall of Longevity, and the Black Cicada Society...

148683.description:
Yan Dun transmigrated into a CEO romance novel as the miserable secretary. He originally thought his task was just to be a tool, observing the romantic entanglements of the Mary Sue and the CEO. However... the situation became increasingly strange. Why did the scenes that originally belonged to the Mary Sue seem to be silently shifting to him? Wasn't he just supposed to be a tool? How did he seem to become a heartthrob?

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Zongcai Wen Li De Mishu

148684.description:
A society in which the livelihood protection system is abolished and people who cannot work are sent to the "experimental district" under the jurisdiction of the government.
An "experimental district" is a place to create a special environment or system in an isolated area and explore how much humans can adapt to it. There are "self-sufficient economic districts" and "cybercommunity districts", but there are also districts such as "untreated plague districts" and "war districts" that are aimed at extremely inhumane experiments.

Akito Kuze, who lost his parents in a sudden accident, decided to enter the 13th experimental district during his second year of high school.
It was literally a "lawless district" with minimal public services and living expenses, but no police or other public institutions in the district. To prove it, people die from the first day of Kuze's entrance.

Can Kuze survive? And what is the "truth" of the experimental district he sees ...?　

(Source: COMIC MeDu, translated)

Sumiko Kiyota is a plain, serious girl. While eating lunch alone as usual, Yuki Shirakawa, the most beautiful and popular girl in class, calls out to her...?

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

Twins separated when they were young lived drastically different lives, but then they both fell in love with the same master in a tragic love triangle.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

148693.description:
I, who held the speedrunning record of several difficult RPGs, was suddenly transmigrated into a game that resembled the real world. I was always looking for interesting RPGs to play, but it turned out that my own life was the most interesting RPG of all. What's this about login rewards? Who are these random women? There are too many complicated features for me to understand. However, it looks like if I don't figure them out in time, I might just die.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148694.description:
It was in the spring of the third year of junior high when Shizuka Morimoto and Tou Oowada first met again. They met again with bitter memories of their middle school days.
The two were separated again after graduating from junior high without mending their relationship. But they met again for the second time in the summer of their second year of high school. Even if it was awkward this time, the distance between the two gradually became closer. But what came at the end of their closeness was their third separation...

148698.description:
The Shengjia Empress toyed with a cute guy on the street, not realizing he was Jiang Mu, the most feared man in the wuxia world, and the lord of Shengyun Mountain. In retaliation, he kidnapped the empress and took her to Shengyun Mountain, to force her to experience the life of the common people. He thought she'd suffer with the bad food and poor accommodations, but she actually enjoyed the experience. Furthermore, she turned out to be quite the charmer, and even Master Jiang himself seemed to be falling into her trap...

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

148699.description:
Everyone has one or two things they don't want you to know. The secret of Aoyagi, a 29-year-old office worker, is that he is gay. For Aoyagi, who pays his sex friends to fulfill his body, love is like a dream from another dimension. The prince of his heart is Asagiri, a 37-year-old super-elite from the same company. A brief conversation with the prince in the lift in the morning is his daily happiness. And yet! One day, the prince finds out his secret! And what's more, the prince actually has a terrible secret too...?!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

148701.description:
"I like him so much, I want to lick him!"

Adachi, who was in the same class with Murao, had eyelashes, eyes, lips, hair color, skin color, everything Murao liked. "I just want to lick him! If only he wasn't a man."

Then one day, Murao gets injured in gym class and Adachi kisses him in the infirmary and says, "I want you to like more than just my face." The obsessed beautiful boy and the sex-crazed boy lick each other!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

148702.description:
Attracted to the daughter of his adulterous partner.
The guilty sense of immorality and the exciting sense of youth that comes to mind. A sensual forbidden love story!

Yuma Tenjokoshi is a married salaryman working in the sales department of a medium-sized food manufacturer.
One day, he had an affair with Honoka Yagiri, his boss who had always looked down on him.
Then, he met the innocent and beautiful Aoi. The encounter with the young girl caused a tingle of "immorality" and "sweet thrill" in his heart!

Salaryman x Boss (mother) x JK (daughter)
Raw emotions and idealistic love intersect in this sexy story of man and women...

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

148707.description:
Ren is a successful photographer who wants for neither status nor money. Yet, there is one thing he cannot satisfy: a primal urge to be savagely dominated. Having never met a Dom capable of meeting his needs, his self-loathing for his Sub nature only intensifies as his health begins to fail under the weight of his unfulfilled instincts. Even the strongest suppressants on the market can no longer keep them at bay. When his physical suffering reaches its peak, Ren is suddenly brought to his knees by a Command from Sou, a florist delivering to his set. Instantly recognizing Sou as an exceptionally brutal Dom who mirrors his own bottomless hunger, Ren experiences a level of satisfaction he never thought possible. Sou proposes a relationship designed to leave them both finally and fully satisfied, but Ren has his own reasons for why he can never truly accept him.

(Source: Renta!)

ミッドナイト・スパイシー・セックス

148709.description:
“I don’t mind lending you my d*ck. In return, treat it like a treasure, alright?”

It’s been a month since I, who cannot be satisfied unless “that” is XL sized, have been unable to come with my favorite toy. Having reached the peak of frustration, with no other options, I chose my childhood friend, Yukihiko. I had no expectations, but Yukihiko’s thing was larger than I thoughtーー.

My ordinary childhood friend turned into a big dicked sadist!? Suddenly diving into urethra play is too much!!
I’m loved deep to my core by my obsessive type sadist childhood friend…

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

148716.description:
Popular college student, Seung-Jae Lee's got it all, when it comes to wealth, connections, physique, but everytime he spends a night with a girlfriend, he immediately gets dumped. After one of these break ups, Seung-Jae spends the night drinking and on his way home runs into and catches up with Ui-Seong Kim, a friend from high school.
Seung-Jae drunk-confesses all of his problems and Ui-Seong convinces him to re-enact everything that he tried with his previous girlfriends, causing the two to end up having sex.
The next day, Seung-Jae realizes he did something crazy yet asks how last night was. Ui-Seong replies, “I don't know, maybe I'll know if you show me one more time,” tempting Seung-Jae again.

Can Seung-Jae stay friends like old times while still having sex with Ui-Seong? But unexpectedly, Ui-Seong has a secret to reveal, but it's become a shade...?

The handsome and ever-so-popular Yong-Gi seems to have it all. But looks can be deceiving, and he's definitely playing the long con – he's not the Casanova everyone thinks he is! One day, his former classmate Su-Yeon joins him at the workplace. Will she be the one to finally soothe his anxious heart?

148728.description:
Everyone knows about the book Liaozhai Zhiyi and its collection of ghost stories. In it are all sorts of ghosts and spirits, some are kind and good, some are wicked and deadly. Each story has its own plot and characters, encompassing ghosts, youkai, kitsune, and more. The one who helps you might not be human, and the ones who hurt you might not be spirits. The evils hidden in the human heart far exceeds anything in the spirit world. We will present the classic Liaozhai stories with realistic art and modern dialog, to make them more relatable for you.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

148731.description:
Lu Yan, the light of Xiacheng District, the lead singer of a well-known underground band, a musical genius, looks like "the leader of X sect". The new neighbor Xiao Heng only thinks that he is a dog who can't play the guitar ...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148732.description:
After breaking up with his girlfriend, grad student Haruaki Fusaishi goes on a motorcycle trip to forget her, only to end up stranded in the remote settlement of Yasumizu. The next day, as he is repairing his bike, a mysterious mist drifts in, and all the villagers shelter inside their homes. Confused, Haruaki sees a mysterious figure with the body of a human and the head of a wolf that kills him.

Haruaki finds that instead of dying, however, he has instead looped back in time. After managing to hide from the creature this time, he discovers the village must engage in a ritual known as a "feast." Several of them have been replaced with spirits of ancient "wolves" that will kill one villager each night, and it is up to the villagers to discover who amongst them are the wolves, and execute them. Caught in an all-out war of doubt and trust, can Haruaki survive and discover the mysteries behind the feast and his looping...?

148733.description:
What the hell?! Sese Yan was murdered thanks to her evil step-mother and her fiancé. But guess what? She wakes up in the past, with a second chance at life, revenge… and even love! She’s got a decade's worth of knowledge (beware, crime lords!) and a newfound fighting spirit. Sese even finds unexpected help from the handsome and rich Jinchen Fu. Can Sese and Jinchen stop history from repeating itself? Will she get upgraded to the good life or will death catch up to her once again?

(Source: Tapas)

"Swear... You won't fall in love with me."

A thousand years ago, they were tragically torn apart. From then on, their souls have been bound, fated to be reincarnated together countless times. Yet they aren't meant to be. In every lifetime, he meets an unfortunate end. In this life, she's been reborn as Amelia, the daughter of a count. He lives again as William, the son of a marquess.

"This time, I won't allow him to die!" Determined to defy fate, Amelia resolves to play the part of a cold-hearted lady to ensure they never fall in love. But, fate has other plans when William approaches her with a marriage proposal...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

148742.description:
Far beyond the reach of the castle walls lies the Far Frontier, home to the "Guardians"—a group of watchmen whose duties consist of little more than idle patrols. Ashath, an aristocrat, is assigned to this remote outpost after being exiled for leading his company of soldiers to their demise. Burdened by the guilt of being the sole survivor, Ashath is tormented by relentless nightmares—until Durant, a gifted mage, uses his powers to free him from this vicious cycle. Despite Durant's sharp tongue, his clumsy kindness reaches Ashath, leading him to confess, "I think I've fallen for you."

(Source: Kuma)

However she has become known as an infamous playgirl! The kind and gentle priest, the happy and hearty paladin, and the richest heir of the kingdom have all become fishes in her personal pond! There are even rumors of her doing unsavory things with her own brother! Because of all that, her first love, Halls, has slowly drifted away from her friendship. It turns out that her trip to the other world may have been a calculated plot…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

148773.description:
Since ancient times, the path of cultivating immortals has been controlled by the Xuanmen family, and it is not something that ordinary people can covet. Zhang Yan from the apocalyptic world received the help of a mysterious residual jade, but he wanted to fight against the enemy with the body of a mortal, vowing to step out on a road of longevity that belongs to him!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

148775.description:
I was caught up in a summoning ritual and pulled to another world. But I was treated as a nuisance, until Leon, the commander of the Second Knights Battalion, saved me. He was super strong and handsome! He was blunt but kind and always took care of me. But why does he get so nervous when I take off my glasses?

Underneath the thick-rimmed glasses is a beautiful girl! The knight commander will fall in love and dote on her with all his might!

It's just a story about a clueless leader and his worthless underlings shamelessly playing around and saving the world. An otaku loser suddenly became the leader of an empire, blessed with a charm that allowed him to collect lolis. This is a slapstick comedy about an otaku and his useless army...

148839.description:
Abandoned young Su Hao from a wealthy family fell into the sewers. He got a blessing in disguise and was ordered to install the X system. With the moonlight treasure box given by the system, he traveled to ten years ago and started a new life.

In my last life, I lived like a dog, those who hated me celebrated, and those who loved me had tears in their eyes. In this life, the Moonlight Treasure Box sent me back, the people who love me, sing and dance, and those who hate me, are in tears.

Casarte gave birth to a pair of twins, which coincided with the return of Casablanca's victory. In order to appease him, the fourth generation of Ghana, at the suggestion of the queen, the great wizard was invited to bless the two baby girls with divination. Through divination, the great wizard predicted that the twins, one good and the other evil, one would bring endless prosperity to the empire, while the other would bring endless misfortune.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The protagonist Chang Zaikun has been able to see terrifying "weird" creatures ever since he was a child, but he was never afraid, rather deeply attracted by the creatures and fell in love with them from the bottom of his heart. One day in high school, he accidentally met a weird administrator and received an invitation: to manage a "prison" inhabited by the creatures, and to find those who were lost in the world!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148843.description:
When you gaze at others, there's also a pair of eyes gazing at you from behind...
Surveillance and counter-surveillance, eavesdropping or stealing hearts?
When specialized professional talent [Fu Ying] meets a high-IQ, cunning old lover [Zhong Qiu], the chase across fate officially begins—
Every accidental encounter you create is precisely my carefully arranged plan. Every trap you personally design, I've already laid an ambush at the bottom.
A match of equal strength, the thrill of facing a worthy opponent... How much sincerity lies behind the deception?
One wrong move, and the whole game is lost, but this time, I'm willing to bet and concede defeat. I only hope you can soften your heart for me, even if just for a second...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148844.description:
Qing Shang Bayin, originally responsible for guarding the world, was sealed into the "Game Metaverse World" during a battle with the ancient evil god Chang Xian. To fight against Chang Xian, seven teenagers were summoned from different worlds. Each of the Seven Luminaries Boys possesses extraordinary abilities and the "divine soul" of a feline. In a world already plunged into despair, they formed a band, expanded their influence, and used music as their weapon to fight Chang Xian and his minions. Ultimately, they rescued Qing Shang Bayin, who was trapped in the game world, and returned the world to its original guardian.

As a fitting epilogue to the unforgettable manga series, readers can catch a glimpse of the future of some characters featured in the original story. Includes special notes by Kouga-sensei.

(Source: BLU Manga)

148850.description:

148851.description:
Corporate slave Yuuto, under the influence of drunkeness, summoned the demon Morax. He made a contract with him where, in return of granting a single wish, Morax would receive his soul. Yuuto had used his wish to “become happy,” and so began his comfortable life of ordering around a demon. However, Morax is the type of demon that feeds off of human bodily fluids and vitality. Because of that, Yuuto ends up having sex with him! They continue this strange cohabitation with a demon…?!

148852.description:
“I love Ryuuji more than as a brother.”

Maki and Ryuuji are blood brothers. Maki had been prone to sickness ever since he was a child, and thus spent a long time in the hospital. Ryuuji, Maki’s energetic brother who’s younger than him by 3 years, would visit him everyday.

To Maki, he was adorable and dear. Ryuuji loved moving his body around, and would dance in front of Maki. The former eventually started taking dancing classes. Little by little, their lives started to move away from each other. Days and months passed, Maki was discharged from the hospital and became a college student, while Ryuuji became a high school student. They were finally able to live in the same house as a “family”, however Maki slowly began to realise a “sense of discomfort towards Ryuuji” in his heart. Finally, when Ryuuji decides to debut under a group called “Spica”…?

A pair of ghosts are sent to the living world to help the undead fulfill their wishes they couldn't fulfill when alive.

Catia has always hid her face under a mask during her days at the academy. Now, right in the middle of the graduation party, her fiancé the First Prince calls off their engagement, accusing her of being as mean-hearted as her ugly appearance. But he should've thought twice, because after all, who ever said beneath the mask was an ugly face?

(Source: Comikey)

Hiragishi Fumi works at a municipal park, but recently, the presence of Hasuike Tetsurou who was assigned from the City Hall has caught his interest. His long finger stimulates my sensitive place. At the same time, his hot tongue licks there repeatedly and makes it feel numb and I feel more and more strange… Kiryu Kairi, whom I had a traumatic romantic experience with, transferred to my cosmetics company where the male to female ratio is 9:1. With his looks and personality, he instantly became popular among the female staff… Huh? Did he forget that we were classmates? But I will not be fooled like when I was in high school! So I decided to get revenge on him, but instead, he pinned me down and said “naughty girls have to be punished”?!

Waking up two decades earlier right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life.

She hatches a plan to anull her marriage remarry the Duke, Ian Tyrone, infamous for being ""IMPOTENT"" for never showing any interest in the ladies.
Maybe his disinterest in women would allow Olivia to comfortably live as his wife, unburdened by childbirth and free of any other pressures in life.

But wait, the Duke who seemingly ""couldn't get it up"" turns out to be a complete stud at in the bedroom. What has Olivia gotten herself into?"
